holdout_policy: The holdout is the deterministic one-third split within every sampling stratum. Do not inspect its game results or tune against it during routine Phase 2 work; reserve it for infrequent promotion decisions.

criteria.check: side to move is not in check
criteria.evaluation: highest-depth eval first PV; no mate; abs(cp) <= 50
criteria.fen_counters: history-free normalization to halfmove 0 and fullmove 1
criteria.strata: phase, side to move, capture availability, and (outside endgames) castling rights
criteria.terminal: non-terminal; no pre-root history; sufficient material

selection.method: per-stratum reservoir sampling followed by deterministic 2:1 splitting

phase_definition.units: queen=4, rook=2, bishop=1, knight=1; both colors; maximum 24

source.evaluation_source: Stockfish evaluations contributed through Lichess analysis
